notes.text: The assembly story has ben Sisi, with his count of eighty benches.
This Yerushalmi gives bar Susi on the threshing floor, the parallel to Maasrot.
The parallel bench-count passage uses bar Susai, distinct from the form in Berakhot.
The threshing-floor report is digitally located in 1:4:6, with bar Sisai in the pinned Hebrew. Preserve Sisin as the compiler’s reported form.
The Yerushalmi has Yaakov be-Rabbi Susai speaking before Yose about harvesting and piling produce.
The source has the exact Yaakov bar Susai and Yose wording, at digital 2:7:2. Keep the printed locator alongside it.
The end of HaKore Lemafrea has Yaakov bar Susi objecting before Yosah about travel to give new-moon testimony.
